title: Kaizen trace event
description: One JSONL line in ~/.claude/.kaizen/indexes/trace/events.jsonl (v1.22.0+ path; previously ~/.claude/.kaizen-trace/events.jsonl). Producer: trace.py via hooks/_trace.sh, llm_proxy.py, daemon.py, browser_mcp.py. Consumer: trace.py query/tail, trace_index.py for semantic search, observe.py.

ts.description: ISO UTC timestamp with millisecond precision (e.g. 2026-05-12T00:30:00.123Z).

src.description: Event source — which subsystem emitted it.

evt.description: Event name, free-form within the src namespace (e.g. 'PreToolUse-bash', 'UserPromptSubmit', 'chat-completion').

sid.description: Claude Code session id (uuid form). Empty when not applicable (e.g. plugin-level events).

tool.description: Tool name for src=hook | src=tool events (e.g. 'Bash', 'Edit', 'Read').

ms.description: Duration in milliseconds for timed events. Null when the event has no duration semantic.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Shape varies by src+evt; not constrained here. NEVER embedded in semantic search vectors regardless of --embed-data flag (only specific safe fields per kaizen privacy policy).
